Important Reminders

 

Related Documentation:

Ø Agent transfers and reassignments: Transfer Guidelines.

Action Item Reminders:

Ø When using the Broker/Dealer (B/D) action code AIBD, submit on the Agency file. Do not send to the B/D Level 10, Level 11 or B/D Level 01 files.

Ø When accessing the B/D's Image file in the system header, precede the B/D number with the letter "B" (for example, B12345).

Ø Always verify documentation authenticity before processing sensitive transactions.
